# Fig — `trusted_novel_funnel` caption (generated by `scripts/manuscript_figures/trusted_novel_funnel.py`)

Fig | Pre-registered trusted-novel definition vs Kinnex long-read truth: 52% concordance, target 70% not met (negative result). Input = the final PBMC 10k v3 precision default (IP arm, PeakATail code 4efeb125; 44,394 sites on primary contigs). Definition (13 §3, committed before any number existed): clip-supported ∧ ≥2 molecules ∧ not internal priming ∧ canonical hexamer (any of 12) at −40..−5 ∧ ≥100 bp from any PolyASite 2.0 site → 6,628 trusted-novel sites (14.9%, 3,350 genes; 4,037 with AATAAA/ATTAAA). Truth = Kinnex x3p poly(A)-verified 3′ ends (different donor); hit = within 25 bp, same strand; Wilson 95% CIs; null = sites shuffled within gene bodies (10 seeds). Result: 0.521 [0.509–0.533] at ≥5 UMI (3,454 / 6,628); 0.261 / 0.073 / 0.013 at ≥20 / ≥100 / ≥500 UMI — the pre-registered ≥0.70 target is not met at any threshold. Robustness (verifier, not part of the pre-registered metric): GEM-X truth 0.554; x3p + GEM-X pooled 0.623 at 25 bp (0.698 at 50 bp, 0.739 at 100 bp). The sites are far from random (enrichment ~71× over the null at ≥5 UMI, empirical p at the 1/11 floor), but the target was an absolute fraction. Every plotted value: `results/figures/manuscript/trusted_novel_funnel*.tsv`.

**Panel a** — the pre-registered funnel as horizontal bars (sites retained, % of input) with, on the right, each
stage's concordance at ≥5 UMI: input 0.786 → clip / ≥2 molecules / not-IP 0.786 (no-op: the caller already
enforces them) → hexamer 0.828 (+0.042) → atlas-novel = trusted-novel 0.521 (−0.307) → strong hexamer 0.525
(+0.004). The atlas-novelty stage is the one that moves concordance; the dashed line is the 0.70 target.
**Panel b** — concordance vs truth stringency (x = Kinnex UMI threshold 5 / 20 / 100 / 500, log) for
trusted-novel (n = 6,628), its strong-hexamer subset (4,037), the atlas-known hexamer-pass complement as
calibration (27,564: 0.902 / 0.715 / 0.393 / 0.144), the full precision default (44,394: 0.786 / 0.576 /
0.289 / 0.101), the atlas-novel hexamer-FAIL set as diagnostic (5,972: 0.528 — the hexamer adds nothing among
atlas-novel sites) and the ≥1-molecule trusted-novel sensitivity arm (37,438: 0.309); grey line = null mean
(0.007 at ≥5 UMI) with the true 10-seed range (0.006–0.008) as a band — the band is not widened for visibility. **Panel c** — feature class (Ensembl 99, strand-matched, hierarchical 3′UTR > other
exon > intron > intergenic): trusted-novel 15.6% 3′UTR / 7.5% / 68.6% intron / 8.3%, atlas-known hexamer-pass
70.1% / 5.0% / 17.8% / 7.1%; below, the fraction of sites within 25 bp of a Kinnex x3p terminus flagged as
internal priming (decoy): trusted-novel 24.5% (1,626 / 6,628), strong 14.6%, full default 11.2%, atlas-known
hexamer-pass 6.6%. **Panel d (boxed, POST HOC)** — trusted-novel concordance at ≥5 and ≥20 UMI split by
feature class (3′UTR 0.78 / 0.56, n = 1,032; other exon 0.66 / 0.41, n = 499; intron 0.45 / 0.18, n = 4,550;
intergenic 0.50 / 0.22, n = 547) and by clip-molecule support (2: 0.43 / 0.16, n = 3,847; 3–4: 0.56 / 0.26,
n = 1,570; ≥5: 0.75 / 0.59, n = 1,211 = the file's 5–9 and 10+ bins pooled). Exploratory only.

**Must travel with it.**
- **This is a negative result and must be written as one.** The paper makes no "trusted novel" claim: the
  pre-registered definition reaches 0.521, not ≥0.70, and it is missed under every truth choice (x3p 0.521,
  GEM-X 0.554, pooled 0.623 at the pre-registered 25 bp). Do not quote the 50-bp (0.698) or 100-bp (0.739)
  pooled numbers as meeting the target — neither is the pre-registered window.
- **Panel d is post hoc.** The 3′UTR (0.78) and ≥5-molecule (0.75) strata were chosen after seeing the data;
  they are diagnostic input for a separately pre-registered v2 definition (3′UTR-restricted and/or ≥5
  molecules and/or a Kinnex-style IP rule, Stage-1d) that must be validated on data not used here (e.g. a
  held-out truth set after the Stage-1d re-run). Never call a de novo site "trusted" on the strength of
  panel d. The ≥5 bin pools the file's 5–9 (0.734 / 0.526, n = 627) and 10+ (0.760 / 0.658, n = 584) bins.
- Truth is site-level, not sample-level: both Kinnex sets come from donors other than the PBMC 10k v3 donor,
  so a site used here but absent (or <5 UMI) in the long-read donor counts as a miss. This caps the attainable
  fraction (atlas-known hexamer-pass: 0.90 x3p / 0.94 pooled at ≥5 UMI; ≈0.39–0.44 at ≥100 UMI, where the
  target is unattainable for any set). Donor mismatch cannot explain the 0.28–0.38 gap because the atlas-known
  complement scores 0.90–0.94 under the same truths. The target is meaningfully testable only against the
  ≥5-UMI (or pooled) truth.
- Enrichment over the shuffled null (~70–250×, empirical p at the 1/11 floor with 10 seeds) says the sites
  are not random; it does not rescue the target, which was an absolute fraction.
- The hexamer criterion adds +0.042 on the whole default output but nothing among atlas-novel sites
  (hexamer-FAIL 0.528 vs trusted-novel 0.521); the atlas-novelty stage costs −0.307. Say "the novelty
  criterion selects the sites the long reads see least", not "the hexamer filter validates the novel sites".
- Funnel stages clip-supported / ≥2 molecules / not-IP remove nothing because the pre-registered default
  already enforces them (the IP flag lives in `run/03_gtf_annotation/default/annotatedpas.bed:10`, not in the
  9-column top-level file; re-deriving IP from the genome would flag 389–736 sites, ≤3%). PolyA_DB could not be
  used (hg19 only); "≥100 bp from any atlas site" means PolyASite 2.0 only.
- 24.5% of trusted-novel sites coincide with a Kinnex internal-priming decoy terminus (6.6% for atlas-known
  hexamer-pass): the caller's IP rule (−10..+30, ≥6 A or ≥70% A) is looser than Kinnex's (≥12 of 18 A in
  +1..+18). The residual false-positive class is internal priming the filter does not catch (issue 10
  addendum, `--ip-rule kinnex`). Decoy-proximal sites are only modestly less concordant (0.46 vs 0.54), so
  the decoy overlap is a plausible mechanism, not a proven one.
- Single PBMC donor, single CellRanger BAM; Kinnex x3p t5 truth is itself permissive (only ~15% of t5 peaks
  are within 25 bp of PolyASite); signed distances are asymmetric (Kinnex termini sit a few bp upstream of the
  PeakATail cleavage coordinate) — no effect within the 25-bp window.
- Panel a's percentages are relative to the 44,413-site default (x-axis label; 19 sites on unlisted contigs are
  excluded before the funnel, so the 44,394-site "input" row is 99.96%, shown as 100%); all concordance
  denominators are the on-contig counts. The 3,350-gene count (subtitle only) and the 44,413 denominator are
  recorded in `trusted_novel_funnel_reference_lines.tsv`.
